label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 65
title: MVP: pipeline workflow page with interactive diagram (stages/agents/sub-agents/roles/artifacts/models) + embedded PDF
body: A dedicated Workflow page rendering the E2E pipeline as a diagram: stages -> agents (with their SUB-AGENTS nested inside), each agent's role, the ARTIFACTS it consumes and produces (what passes to the next agent), and the MODEL currently assigned (from the active tier). Interactive (hover/click -> agent detail + artifacts + model) AND a generated diagram (draw.io/mermaid source -> SVG/PDF) EMBEDDED in the page. Reuse core/architecture_diagram + pipeline.drawio/mermaid + the new /api/v1 endpoints; render PDF via the artifact renderer (BI-0084). Extends BI-0027/BI-0028.
